content.text: In regions like Nigeria and Venezuela, traditional payment platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-13|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and PayPal often restrict digital creators from accessing essential payment processing. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-17|coremerch]] offers a robust alternative through Stack 02 on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-11|Cloudflare Workers]] Pages, allowing you to build a crypto store effortlessly. This guide provides a detailed roadmap to deploy your digital store without reliance on conventional platforms, ensuring full ownership and operational sovereignty.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The failure of traditional payment platforms often stems from geographic restrictions and financial isolation. In contrast, COREMERCH's infrastructure empowers creators to establish their own digital stores, leveraging decentralized payment solutions. By utilizing Stack 02, which combines Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you gain the ability to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, bypassing the limitations imposed by conventional financial systems. This architecture ensures that you maintain full ownership of your data and products, providing resilience against platform failures.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating your deployment on Cloudflare Pages, gather the necessary tools and accounts. You will need a Cloudflare account to access Pages and Workers, as well as a NOWPayments account to process cryptocurrency transactions. Prepare your digital products, such as ebooks or courses, and organize them for upload. Ensure you have the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) on hand, which includes complete documentation and source code for effective integration. Having these resources ready will streamline your deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital products. Utilize Cloudflare Workers to build the backend logic required for processing orders. Once your backend setup is complete, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. This stage involves setting up webhooks to automate payment confirmations, ensuring a seamless order process for customers. After configuring these components, conduct thorough testing to validate that your payment pipeline functions correctly before going live.
Build your store with full ownership and no middlemen.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After testing your setup, it’s time to launch your store. Promote your digital products through social media and other marketing channels to attract potential customers. When a customer makes a purchase, they will pay using cryptocurrency, triggering the webhook you set up with NOWPayments. Monitor the transaction to ensure it processes smoothly, and deliver the digital product automatically through your established delivery pipeline. This step marks the transition from setup to operation, solidifying your independent online presence.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is operational, consider strategies for scaling your business. Analyze customer feedback to improve product offerings and enhance user experience. You can expand your product line, increase marketing efforts, or explore partnerships with other creators. Regularly review your infrastructure to optimize performance and ensure security. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides insights on scaling effectively, ensuring your store continues to grow without being reliant on any third-party platforms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without KYC or buyer accounts.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a Cloudflare account for Pages and Workers. Register an account with NOWPayments for crypto processing. Prepare your digital products for upload. Acquire The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for comprehensive documentation. Set up your Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Configure Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments and set up webhooks. Test every component thoroughly. Launch your store and promote your products. Monitor transactions and optimize your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to deploy Stack 02?
Deploying Stack 02 typically takes 48 hours. COREMERCH ensures that the deployment is end-to-end tested before handing it off to you, guaranteeing a smooth setup experience.
Can I use GitHub Pages for my digital store?
Yes, you can use GitHub Pages to host a digital store, particularly with Stack 01. However, Stack 02 on Cloudflare Pages provides enhanced features and scalability.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving you flexibility in payment options and ensuring that your customers can pay using their preferred currency.
Is there a fee for using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction. This competitive rate makes it a cost-effective option for processing crypto payments.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours for deployment. Stack 02, on the other hand, uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, with a deployment time of 48 hours and more comprehensive features.
No subscriptions, no limitations — just pure infrastructure sovereignty.
